about_the_game:
As a big thank-you for all the love you've poured into "Tiny Pasture", we're excited to drop a free DLC – Round Two! This release brings in two brand-new little buddies – a frog and a duck. With summer upon us, why not invite these lively water-edge chatterboxes over to cool down your desktop pasture?

How to add DLC content to the game

1. Download the DLC.

2. Restart Steam, or head over to your Library, right-click on our game, select Properties, then Installed Files, and click on "Verify Integrity of Game Files."
